args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes (Manufacturing Execution), sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

ORDER-TO-PRODUCTION PROCESSES:
Agent: sap.s4:agent:OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine:v1
- Captures incoming customer orders from sales opportunities
- Validates fulfillment eligibility: customer account eligibility, credit limits, inventory availability

WORKFORCE ALLOCATION & PAYROLL:
Agent: sap.sf:agent:SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1
- Automates workforce capability alignment with project resource requirements
- Monitors employee competencies and coordinates optimal resource allocation
- Processes material/product requirements, automating personnel skill matching
- Facilitates dynamic workforce planning with capability gap evaluation
- Best fit for: Assigning production staff to manufacturing tasks and coordinating labor costing

Agent: sap.sf:agent:CompensationPolicyAutomationEngine:v1
- Automates compensation adjustments per organizational policies
- Processes compensation events for payroll integration
- Supports: payroll-policy-driven salary adjustments

ENGINEERING CHANGE MANAGEMENT:
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1
- Automates engineering change processing and material lifecycle coordination
- Part of multiple production processes

MANUFACTURING CHANGE ORCHESTRATION:
Agent: my.mes:agent:ProductionChangeOrchestrator:v1
- Automates engineering changes across production materials/items
- Capabilities include machine scheduling and work order sequencing

BOM COMPLIANCE & VALIDATION:
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1 (PLM)
Agent: sap.s4:agent:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent:v1 (S4)
Agent: my.mes:agent:BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator:v1

INCIDENT INVESTIGATION & ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS:
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1 ✓
- Autonomously analyzes safety incidents to identify root causes
- Recommends corrective and preventive actions prioritized by risk severity
- Generates structured root cause analysis reports with evidence-based analysis
- Accelerates investigation workflows, ensures consistent analysis
- Works with SafetyIncident, Incident, HazardousSubstance entity types
- Line of Business: Safety and Environment
- BEST FIT for: Production incident investigation and root cause analysis

Agent: sap.ehs:agent:IncidentResponseCoordinator:v1
- Coordinates safety incident workflows and emergency response actions
- Monitors incoming incidents, initiates coordinated response procedures
- Processes severity assessments, routes tickets to response teams

QUALITY MONITORING:
Agent: my.mes:agent:ProductionQualityMonitor:v1
- Monitors QualityInspection outcomes across ProductionOrders
- Detects quality deviations, initiates escalation workflows
- Logs quality incidents for traceability
